scope: Deduplicated external developer/vendor CODA examples, not bank-certified production exports. Complete means record-envelope completeness, not semantic validity.

factExtraction.method: Independent Python fixed-position slicing of decoded original text; no camt2coda parser/converter invoked. Signed decimal values computed using integer thousandths, raw numeric/sign fields retained.
factExtraction.authority: Febelfin CODA v2.6 §§7.5, record1 pp15-16, record21 pp17-18, record8 p26, record9 p28
factExtraction.account_structures: 0 Belgian BBAN,1 foreign BBAN,2 Belgian IBAN,3 foreign IBAN. BBAN in CODA2 is not a legacy version.
factExtraction.record9_count_note: Spec counts records1,2.1,2.2,2.3,3.1,3.2,3.3,8; excludes0,4,9. Globalisation totals include detail_sequence0000; detailed movements can be non-booked.
